title: Qt: Reduce I/O Graph minimum width
description:
Remove the "Time of Day" and "Log Scale" checkboxes from the main
dialog and only access them via the context menu. (There could be
keyboard shortcuts as well.) This reduces the minimum width, especially
on some translations.

Fix #20147
